war_summary: War 139 is on day 86 with no winner and conquest running; victory requires 32 towns (30 short). Colonial forces hold a clear strategic-base majority across the map, controlling full or dominant shares in regions like Acrithia, Allods Bight, Ash Fields, Dead Lands, Mooring County, and Clahstra, while Wardens hold pockets including Basin Sionnach, Callahans Passage, Clanshead Valley, Howl County, Marban Hollow, Reaching Trail, Stlican Shelf, and Viper Pit. The heaviest sustained pressure is in Callahans Passage, Clahstra, Dead Lands, Mooring County, Oarbreaker, Speaking Woods, and Stlican Shelf, where casualty rates are high and enlistments are accelerating. Recent ownership-flip activity is concentrated in Clahstra (21 events/24h), Mooring County (22), Oarbreaker (22), Stlican Shelf (26), Onyx (15), Endless Shore (8), and Olavis Wake (8), with the latest events within minutes at Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf. Uncertainty remains high in split-ownership zones—especially Oarbreaker (5-4), Godcrofts (5-4), Onyx (3-3), Callahans Passage (8-2), and Mooring County (10-2)—where accelerating casualties and active base captures could shift strategic-base counts in the next 24 hours, while fully held regions show little near-term change risk.
